sources.label: KK Yap & Associates XUSD SCS Reserve Account Report, 31 July 2026

reserveReview.rationale: KK Yap & Associates SSAE 3000 (Revised) reasonable-assurance examination as of 31 July 2026 11:59 PM Singapore time, signed 28 August 2026 and reviewed 7 September 2026: USD45,269,767 cash, zero fixed deposits and zero government/repo instruments against USD45,182,310 XUSD in circulation. The four disclosed chain supplies reconcile exactly; the reserve composition remains 100% cash. The report does not identify the safeguarding institution or provider shares.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KK Yap & Associates independent examination as of 31 July 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The examination discloses the complete reserve asset-class allocation. The safeguarding institution and any provider-level allocation remain undisclosed.
